notes: Paper derives constraints on hidden photon (dark photon) mixing angle χ and mass µ using VHE γ-ray observations from the Crab Nebula. The main result is a mass-independent bound χ_fit ≈ 0.0343 (68.3% C.L.) valid for masses µ ≲ 10^-5 eV, obtained by fitting the oscillation signature to combined HEGRA, H.E.S.S., MAGIC, and Whipple data. The bound is encoded as a horizontal line spanning the stated validity range (1e-8 to 1e-5 eV). This represents the first astronomical constraints on hidden photon oscillations using TeV-scale energies and kpc-scale distances. The paper explicitly states this is the best constraint on hidden photon parameters using oscillation effects directly (though Coulomb law tests provide stronger overall limits). | selector: text over figure_vision (quality (1, 1, 1, 1, 3, 0, 0.85, 4))
